Looking at this problem, I need to find meeting times when all 5 people are available. Since Isabella only accepts meetings on Tuesday and Friday (if ≥30 min), those are the only viable days.

Let me convert everyone to a common timezone T (Yolanda/Isabella/Mary/Zoey's local). Claire is 1 hour ahead, so Claire's availability in timezone T is 1 hour earlier than in her local time.

**FRIDAY ANALYSIS:**

First, converting to timezone T:

**Yolanda Friday (T):** 9:00-10:15, 10:55-11:15, 11:35-17:00
**Isabella Friday (T):** 9:00-9:35, 10:55-11:40, 13:10-17:00 (needs ≥30 min)
**Mary Friday (T):** 9:00-9:35, 10:40-10:40, 11:15-12:35, 13:35-17:00
**Zoey Friday (T):** 9:00-9:30, 10:30-11:35, 12:00-13:05, 13:40-18:00 (can stay until 6pm)
**Claire Friday (T):** 8:00-8:30, 8:40-9:20, 9:20-16:00 (her 9am-5pm becomes 8am-4pm in T)

Checking key start times:

**At 13:30 T:** Zoey not free (starts at 13:40) ✗

**At 14:00 T:**
- Yolanda: Free 11:35-17:00 ✓
- Isabella: Free 13:10-17:00 ✓ (meeting ≥30 min requirement will be met)
- Mary: Free 13:35-17:00 ✓  
- Zoey: Free 13:40-18:00 ✓
- Claire: Free until 16:00 T ✓

All available! The meeting can run 14:00-16:00 T = **120 minutes**

**Can we extend beyond 16:00 T?** No - Claire's work day ends at 16:00 T (she works until 5pm in her local time).

**TUESDAY ANALYSIS:**

Converting to timezone T:

**Yolanda Tuesday (T):** 9:00-9:20, 10:45-10:55, 11:45-13:00, 13:30-17:00
**Isabella Tuesday (T):** 9:40-10:50, 12:00-13:15, 14:35-15:15, 16:40-17:00
**Mary Tuesday (T):** 9:00-9:20, 10:05-11:00, 11:05-11:30, 12:25-13:55, 15:15-17:00
**Zoey Tuesday (T):** 9:00-9:50, 10:00-11:05, 11:10-17:00
**Claire Tuesday (T):** 8:00-8:10, 8:40-9:10, 9:15-16:00

**At 12:30 T:**
- Yolanda: Free 11:45-13:00 ✓
- Isabella: Free 12:00-13:15 ✓
- Mary: Free 12:25-13:55 ✓
- Zoey: Free 11:10-17:00 ✓
- Claire: Free 9:15-16:00 ✓

All available! 

**Maximum length:** Yolanda is free until 13:00 but can miss the last 10 minutes, extending to 13:10. Isabella is free until 13:15. So meeting: 12:30-13:10 = **40 minutes**

**COMPARISON:**
- Friday: 120 minutes starting at 14:00 T
- Tuesday: 40 minutes starting at 12:30 T

The longest meeting is **120 minutes**.

**Counting options:** Are there other start times on Friday giving 120 minutes?
- 14:30 T would give 14:30-16:00 = 90 min (not 120)
- Any earlier time: Someone wouldn't be available

Only **1 option**: Friday 14:00-16:00 T

ANSWER: 120, 1
